name: notice-period-check
title: Notice Period Check
description: Notice calculator that works out the last day from the resignation and policy (days, weeks or months; calendar or working days) and flags month-end arithmetic, weekend or holiday last days, HR's time zone dating the email differently, unpaid leave, leave set-off and buyout cost.

meta.stops: Wrong last working day after resigning
meta.summary: Works out the real last working day from a resignation and the notice policy, so nobody resigns towards the wrong date.
catches: Month-end arithmetic such as 31 Jan + 1 month
Last day on a weekend or holiday
Resignation email dated differently in HR's time zone
Unpaid leave pushing the date out, and leave set-off
Buyout cost of leaving early, plus a line to copy to HR
limits: Your contract and policy decide; defaults (notice from the next day) are the common reading, not a rule
Holidays and leave balance come from your props
a11y: Section labelled by its heading; every input has a visible label
The sent-at field's label names the time zone
Focus moves to the first fix after a change

rules.note: Informational, not legal advice. Confirmed the UK reading that notice usually runs from the day after it is handed in. Indian contract practices mentioned in the code were not verified.
